title: rclone to Qnap Webdav fails with subfolders that contain multiple files.
body:
#### What is the problem you are having with rclone? When trying to transfer files to a qnap nas with webdav access setup the transfer fails if the folder i'm trying to transfer has another folder in it with more then 1 file. Also any encrypted transfers fail. If I copy over 1 folder that contains 1 folder and 1 file it transfers ok. Also I can use cyberduck to transfer folders with as many sub folders and files with not issues and I can even create an encrypted vault and transfer files to that. So I beleive that the Qnap Webdav is set up correctly. #### What is your rclone version (eg output from `rclone -V`) ``` rclone v1.41-101-gf9a1a7e7 - os/arch: windows/amd64 - go version: go1.10 ``` #### Which OS you are using and how many bits (eg Windows 7, 64 bit) Windows 10 64 bit #### Which cloud storage system are you using? (eg Google Drive) Qnap TS-451+ #### The command you were trying to run (eg `rclone copy /tmp remote:tmp`) rclone>rclone copy C:\Users\Enlight\Desktop\test_folder1 qnap: -vv #### A log from the command with the `-vv` flag (eg output from `rclone -vv copy /tmp remote:tmp`) ``` c:\Program Files\rclone>rclone copy C:\Users\Enlight\Desktop\test_folder1 qnap: -vv 2018/06/12 22:10:47 DEBUG : rclone: Version "v1.41-101-gf9a1a7e7" starting with parameters ["rclone" "copy" "C:\\Users\\Enlight\\Desktop\\test_folder1" "qnap:" "-vv"] 2018/06/12 22:10:47 DEBUG : Using config file from "C:\\Users\\Enlight\\.config\\rclone\\rclone.conf" 2018/06/12 22:10:48 INFO : webdav root '': Waiting for checks to finish 2018/06/12 22:10:48 INFO : webdav root '': Waiting for transfers to finish 2018/06/12 22:10:48 ERROR : test1/015_10.jpg: Failed to copy: Update mkParentDir failed: 403 Forbidden
